import html # Predefined template for displaying blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Formats a user‑submitted blog post for safe display. Parameters ---------- subject : str The title of the blog post. description : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully sanitized and formatted HTML snippet ready for rendering. Raises ------ ValueError If either `subject` or `description` is empty or None. """ if not subject: raise ValueError("Subject (title) cannot be empty.") if not description: raise ValueError("Description (body) cannot be empty.") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS and ensure well‑formedness. safe_title = html.escape(subject, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Render the final HTML using the template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
